common.contactUs: Need help? Write to office@biocetan.ro or call +40 741 039 292.

login.title: Log in
login.lead: Access for BIOCETAN clients. Accounts are created by invitation.
login.noAccount: No account yet? Ask your BIOCETAN contact to invite you.
login.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Log in with the new one.
login.inviteAccepted: Your account is ready. Log in to continue.
login.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter the email address of your account. If it exists, we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that address, we have sent a link to it. It is valid for 1 hour. Check your Spam folder too.

invite.title: Set up your account
invite.lead: Welcome, {name}. Choose a password to activate your account ({email}).

password.hint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence you can remember works well.

link.invalidBody: It has expired, has already been used, or a newer one was sent. Request a new password reset, or ask your BIOCETAN contact for a new invitation.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.recoveryHint: Lost your phone? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.
mfa.setupLead: Administrator accounts are protected by a second step: a code from an app on your phone, in addition to your password.
mfa.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…).
mfa.step2: In the app, add an account and scan this QR code.
mfa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
mfa.recoveryLead: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you log in once. Store them somewhere safe (a password manager, or printed). They are shown only now.

client.emptyTitle: Your portal is being set up
client.emptyBody: Soon you will find your offers, orders, deliveries, documents and the conversation with our team here. Until then, nothing to do.

admin.noClients: No clients yet. Create the first one.
admin.companyCreated: Company created. Now invite its first user.
admin.inviteAdminLead: Admins have full access to every client. They must set up two-step verification at first login.
admin.name: Full name
admin.userLanguage: Language for emails and the portal
admin.inviteSent: Invitation sent to {email}. The link is valid for 72 hours.
admin.userDisabled: User disabled and logged out everywhere.

errors.passwordCommon: This password is too easy to guess. Choose another.
errors.passwordContainsEmail: Don't use your email address in the password.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.emailTaken: A user with this email already exists.
errors.invalidCode: Wrong or expired code. Try the current one.
errors.mailFailed: The email could not be sent. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.forbidden: You don't have access to this.

email.linkFallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this address into your browser:
email.notYou: If you weren't expecting this email, you can ignore it.

invite.subject: Your BIOCETAN client portal account
invite.body: {inviter} has created an account for you on the BIOCETAN client portal, where you will find offers, orders, deliveries and documents, and can write to our team.
invite.expiry: The link is valid for 72 hours and works once.

reset.subject: Reset your BIOCETAN portal password
reset.body: We received a request to reset the password of your BIOCETAN portal account.
reset.expiry: The link is valid for 1 hour and works once.
reset.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email: your password stays the same.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page doesn't exist or you don't have access to it.
